settings.label: Risk-free interest rate
settings.what_it_changes: The yearly interest rate the pricing reads each expiry's forward with (0.065 means 6.5%). Where the forward comes from live call and put prices, a change mostly shifts the implied dividend yield, so option prices and Greeks move very little; it matters more for long expiries and where the forward is estimated from the index level.
settings.source: ADR-056; was ofo_app/live_market.py LIVE_RATE

settings.label: Forward quality width
settings.what_it_changes: How wide a strike's bid-ask gap may be, as a fraction of its own mid price, for that strike to count in the forward quality figure (0.05 means 5%). It never changes the forward itself.
settings.source: ADR-061, W-060; was ofo/marketdata/forward.py QUALITY_WIDTH

settings.label: Strikes used for the forward
settings.what_it_changes: How many strikes nearest the current index level are read to work out each expiry's forward (the at-the-money strike and an equal number either side).
settings.source: ADR-061; was ofo/marketdata/forward.py STRIKES_NEAR

settings.label: Fewest strikes for the forward
settings.what_it_changes: The fewest strikes with a live buy and sell price on both the call and the put that an expiry's forward needs; with fewer, the forward is estimated from the index level and labelled so.
settings.source: ADR-061; was ofo/marketdata/forward.py MIN_STRIKES

settings.label: NIFTY scenario column step
settings.what_it_changes: The distance in NIFTY points between neighbouring scenario columns. Must be a multiple of the anchor and of the listed strike gap.
settings.source: ADR-042; was ofo/scenario/config.py DEFAULT_CONFIGS

settings.label: NIFTY scenario column anchor
settings.what_it_changes: Scenario columns for NIFTY sit on multiples of this many points. The column step must be a multiple of it.
settings.source: ADR-042; was ofo/scenario/config.py DEFAULT_CONFIGS

settings.label: NIFTY scenario minimum half width
settings.what_it_changes: The default NIFTY scenario range reaches at least this many points each side of spot.
settings.source: ADR-042; was ofo/scenario/config.py DEFAULT_CONFIGS

settings.label: NIFTY scenario margin steps
settings.what_it_changes: How many column steps are added beyond the outermost strike, breakeven, risk boundary or expected move on NIFTY.
settings.source: ADR-042; was ofo/scenario/config.py DEFAULT_CONFIGS

settings.label: NIFTY scenario maximum columns
settings.what_it_changes: A NIFTY scenario range with more columns than this is refused.
settings.source: ADR-042; was ofo/scenario/config.py DEFAULT_CONFIGS

settings.label: SENSEX scenario column step
settings.what_it_changes: The distance in SENSEX points between neighbouring scenario columns. Must be a multiple of the anchor and of the listed strike gap.
settings.source: ADR-042; was ofo/scenario/config.py DEFAULT_CONFIGS

settings.label: SENSEX scenario column anchor
settings.what_it_changes: Scenario columns for SENSEX sit on multiples of this many points. The column step must be a multiple of it.
settings.source: ADR-042; was ofo/scenario/config.py DEFAULT_CONFIGS

settings.label: SENSEX scenario minimum half width
settings.what_it_changes: The default SENSEX scenario range reaches at least this many points each side of spot.
settings.source: ADR-042; was ofo/scenario/config.py DEFAULT_CONFIGS

settings.label: SENSEX scenario margin steps
settings.what_it_changes: How many column steps are added beyond the outermost strike, breakeven, risk boundary or expected move on SENSEX.
settings.source: ADR-042; was ofo/scenario/config.py DEFAULT_CONFIGS

settings.label: SENSEX scenario maximum columns
settings.what_it_changes: A SENSEX scenario range with more columns than this is refused.
settings.source: ADR-042; was ofo/scenario/config.py DEFAULT_CONFIGS

settings.source: REQ-079 AC-7; was ofo/strategy/placement.py QUICK_PICK_DISTANCES

settings.label: SENSEX strangle quick pick 3

settings.label: What-if target span

settings.source: REQ-084 AC-1; was ofo/engine/target.py TARGET_SPAN

settings.label: Payoff table step 1
settings.what_it_changes: Payoff table interval number 1 a user may pick, in index points.
settings.source: REQ-137 AC-1; was ofo/outcome/service.py PAYOFF_TABLE_STEPS

settings.label: Payoff table step 2
settings.what_it_changes: Payoff table interval number 2 a user may pick, in index points.
settings.source: REQ-137 AC-1; was ofo/outcome/service.py PAYOFF_TABLE_STEPS

settings.label: Payoff table step 3
settings.what_it_changes: Payoff table interval number 3 a user may pick, in index points.
settings.source: REQ-137 AC-1; was ofo/outcome/service.py PAYOFF_TABLE_STEPS

settings.label: Payoff table step 4
settings.what_it_changes: Payoff table interval number 4 a user may pick, in index points.
settings.source: REQ-137 AC-1; was ofo/outcome/service.py PAYOFF_TABLE_STEPS

settings.label: NIFTY payoff table default step
settings.what_it_changes: The payoff table interval for NIFTY when none is picked.
settings.source: REQ-137 AC-1; was ofo/outcome/service.py PAYOFF_TABLE_DEFAULT_STEPS

settings.label: SENSEX payoff table default step
settings.what_it_changes: The payoff table interval for SENSEX when none is picked.
settings.source: REQ-137 AC-1; was ofo/outcome/service.py PAYOFF_TABLE_DEFAULT_STEPS

settings.label: SD band horizon
settings.what_it_changes: The number of calendar days the one and two standard deviation bands cover (the days to the nearest expiry when fewer).
settings.source: D-B20; was ofo/outcome/service.py SD_HORIZON_DAYS

settings.label: Feed silent for (stale)
settings.what_it_changes: How long the live price feed may send no price before every quote on it reads stale (and a spot from the feed is no longer used). A smaller number flags a quiet feed sooner and may warn more often.
settings.source: ADR-222, REQ-167 AC-5, F-32; was ofo/marketdata/feed_health.py FEED_STALE

settings.label: Feed reconnect window
settings.what_it_changes: How long a dropped price-feed connection may keep trying to reconnect before its quotes read unavailable instead of stale.
settings.source: ADR-222, REQ-167 AC-5; was ofo/marketdata/feed_health.py RECONNECT_WINDOW

settings.label: Open strategy push interval
settings.what_it_changes: The shortest time between two live updates of one strategy open on a screen (also the chain and indices screens). A larger number means fewer updates and less server work.
settings.source: ADR-068 (2), REQ-166 AC-1; was ofo_app/live_push.py MIN_PUSH_INTERVAL

settings.label: Per-option figures interval
settings.what_it_changes: The shortest time between two recalculations of one option's shared figures (implied volatility and Greeks). A larger number means fewer recalculations and less server work.
settings.source: ADR-220 (3), REQ-166 AC-1; was ofo_app/calc_speeds.py _STAND_IN

settings.label: Safety valve step 1
settings.what_it_changes: The open-screen and background interval while the maths work keeps up (the safety valve's first step).
settings.source: ADR-220 (3), REQ-166 AC-3; was ofo_app/calc_speeds.py _STAND_IN

settings.label: Safety valve step 2
settings.what_it_changes: The open-screen and background interval after the maths work first falls behind (the safety valve's second step).
settings.source: ADR-220 (3), REQ-166 AC-3; was ofo_app/calc_speeds.py _STAND_IN

settings.label: Safety valve step 3
settings.what_it_changes: The open-screen and background interval while the maths work stays behind (the safety valve's last step).
settings.source: ADR-220 (3), REQ-166 AC-3; was ofo_app/calc_speeds.py _STAND_IN

settings.label: Free trial length
settings.what_it_changes: Days of Pro given to a new registration.
settings.source: ADR-091 entitlements; was ofo/entitlements/engine.py TRIAL_DAYS_DEFAULT

settings.label: Referral reward length
settings.what_it_changes: Days of Pro a referral grants.
settings.source: ADR-091 entitlements; was ofo/entitlements/engine.py REFERRAL_DAYS_DEFAULT

settings.label: Freeze-limit file stale after
settings.what_it_changes: The review warns when the stored freeze-limit file is older than this many days.
settings.source: ADR-091, issue 257; was ofo/execution/freeze.py STALE_AFTER_DAYS

settings.label: Largest allowed catalogue drop
settings.what_it_changes: A contract-list update is refused if more than this percent of one index's live contracts would disappear at once.
settings.source: ADR-058; was env CATALOGUE_MAX_DELIST_PERCENT

settings.label: Option chain strikes each side
settings.what_it_changes: The most strikes either side of the at-the-money strike the option chain shows and the server accepts.
settings.source: REQ-167 AC-5; was ofo_app/chain_push.py MAX_STRIKES_EACH_SIDE

settings.label: Longest price history
settings.what_it_changes: The most days of strategy price history one read returns.
settings.source: REQ-167 AC-5; was ofo_app/strategy_price_history.py MAX_DAYS

settings.label: Leg picker width choice 1
settings.what_it_changes: Strikes either side of the at-the-money strike the leg picker offers as choice number 1; the server offers it and accepts it. Choice 1 is the width shown first.
settings.source: REQ-167 AC-5, REQ-080 AC-1; was ofo_app/routes/leg_picker.py WIDTHS and frontend legPicker.js

settings.label: Leg picker width choice 2
settings.what_it_changes: Strikes either side of the at-the-money strike the leg picker offers as choice number 2; the server offers it and accepts it. Choice 1 is the width shown first.
settings.source: REQ-167 AC-5, REQ-080 AC-1; was ofo_app/routes/leg_picker.py WIDTHS and frontend legPicker.js

settings.label: Leg picker width choice 3
settings.what_it_changes: Strikes either side of the at-the-money strike the leg picker offers as choice number 3; the server offers it and accepts it. Choice 1 is the width shown first.
settings.source: REQ-167 AC-5, REQ-080 AC-1; was ofo_app/routes/leg_picker.py WIDTHS and frontend legPicker.js

settings.label: Leg picker width choice 4
settings.what_it_changes: Strikes either side of the at-the-money strike the leg picker offers as choice number 4; the server offers it and accepts it. Choice 1 is the width shown first.
settings.source: REQ-167 AC-5, REQ-080 AC-1; was ofo_app/routes/leg_picker.py WIDTHS and frontend legPicker.js

settings.label: Range pick-list step
settings.what_it_changes: The gap in points between two values of the expected-range pick lists (the Guided Strategy Builder).
settings.source: REQ-167 AC-5, REQ-026 AC-5; was frontend guided.js RANGE_STEP / RANGE_CAP

settings.label: NIFTY range pick-list cap
settings.what_it_changes: The furthest a NIFTY expected-range pick list runs from the current level, in points.
settings.source: REQ-167 AC-5, REQ-026 AC-5; was frontend guided.js RANGE_STEP / RANGE_CAP

settings.label: SENSEX range pick-list cap
settings.what_it_changes: The furthest a SENSEX expected-range pick list runs from the current level, in points.
settings.source: REQ-167 AC-5, REQ-026 AC-5; was frontend guided.js RANGE_STEP / RANGE_CAP

settings.label: Undo window, one leg
settings.what_it_changes: How long Undo stays after one leg is removed.
settings.source: REQ-167 AC-7; F-79; Q-SET-1 default waiting on the owner; was OptionChainPage.vue UNDO_MS

settings.label: Undo window, Clear all
settings.what_it_changes: How long Undo stays after Clear all.
settings.source: REQ-167 AC-7; F-79; Q-SET-1 default waiting on the owner; was legEdit.js CLEAR_UNDO_MS

settings.label: Most lots in one leg
settings.what_it_changes: The most lots one leg of a strategy may hold; a larger leg is refused and the screen's lot box stops there.
settings.source: REQ-167 AC-5; was ofo_app/routes/outcome.py LegIn.lots le=10000 and chainSelection.js MAX_LOTS

settings.label: Highest leg multiplier
settings.what_it_changes: The highest multiplier the leg editor accepts for a leg's base lots.
settings.source: REQ-167 AC-5; was frontend/src/lib/legEdit.js MULTIPLIER_MAX

settings.label: Lot choices in the leg picker
settings.what_it_changes: How many quick lot choices (1, 2, 3 and so on) the leg picker offers.
settings.source: REQ-167 AC-5; was frontend/src/lib/legPicker.js LOT_CHOICES

settings.label: Paper settlement starts at (IST, HHMM)
settings.what_it_changes: From what time on expiry day open paper legs are settled at the index close, and when the settlement job runs each trading day.
settings.source: NSE/BSE publish the index closing value after the 15:30 close; was paper_settlement.py SETTLE_FROM (GC-TP 5b)

settings.label: Paper settlement retries until (IST, HHMM)
settings.what_it_changes: Until what time the settlement job keeps retrying when the index close is not yet available.
settings.source: GC-TP 5b retry window for a late exchange close; was paper_settlement.py RETRY_UNTIL

settings.label: Short-strike delta for approaches (weekly)
settings.what_it_changes: The starting delta an adjustment approach picks a new short strike at on a weekly expiry; each user can set their own on the Adjustments screen.
settings.source: ADR-222 (7), REQ-168 AC-1, AC-5; was ofo/adjustment/approach_config.json target_short_delta.weekly

settings.label: Short-strike delta for approaches (monthly)
settings.what_it_changes: The starting delta an adjustment approach picks a new short strike at on a monthly expiry; each user can set their own.
settings.source: ADR-222 (7), REQ-168 AC-1, AC-5; was ofo/adjustment/approach_config.json target_short_delta.monthly

settings.label: Roll distance without delta (NIFTY)
settings.what_it_changes: The starting distance, in index points, a NIFTY roll moves a short strike when the chain carries no delta; each user can set their own.
settings.source: ADR-222 (7), REQ-168 AC-1, AC-5; was ofo/adjustment/approach_config.json roll_points_without_delta.NIFTY

settings.label: Roll distance without delta (SENSEX)
settings.what_it_changes: The starting distance, in index points, a SENSEX roll moves a short strike when the chain carries no delta; each user can set their own.
settings.source: ADR-222 (7), REQ-168 AC-1, AC-5; was ofo/adjustment/approach_config.json roll_points_without_delta.SENSEX

settings.label: Roll basis
settings.what_it_changes: Where a roll places the new short strike: 1 = Target delta (the first listed strike at or under the playbook's target delta; the default), 2 = Entry distance from spot (the short keeps the distance from spot it had at entry, snapped to a listed strike; spread widths are kept). Each strategy's plan can override it.
settings.source: ADR-243, REQ-046 Q255; was never typed in code (new in ADR-243: rolls were fixed at the target delta)

settings.label: Fewest days left for the iron fly approach
settings.what_it_changes: The starting number of days to expiry below which the convert-to-iron-fly approach is not offered; each user can set their own.
settings.source: ADR-222 (7), REQ-168 AC-1, AC-5; was ofo/adjustment/approach_config.json iron_fly_min_days_left

settings.label: Reduce approach divisor
settings.what_it_changes: The starting divisor of the reduce approach: it closes the tested spread's lots divided by this number (2 closes half); each user can set their own.
settings.source: ADR-222 (7), REQ-168 AC-1, AC-5; was ofo/adjustment/approach_config.json reduce_divisor

settings.label: Partial close percent
settings.what_it_changes: The starting share of every leg's lots the partial close approach closes (50 closes half); a share that is not a whole number of lots is not built; each user can set their own.
settings.source: ADR-238 (2), REQ-168 AC-1; catalogue A-25 and S-12; was never typed in code (new in ADR-238)

settings.label: Untested short fall before closing it
settings.what_it_changes: How far, in percent of its entry price, the short leg of the side spot is moving away from must have fallen before the close-the-untested-side approach is built (80 means it now costs 20% of its entry or less); each user can set their own.
settings.source: ADR-238 (3), REQ-168 AC-1; catalogue A-26, 80 to 90 percent; was never typed in code (new in ADR-238)

settings.label: Strikes to shift a spread by
settings.what_it_changes: How many listed strikes the shift approach moves the short and wing of the side spot is pressing on, away from spot (1 moves them to the next listed strike); each user can set their own.
settings.source: ADR-239 (3), REQ-168 AC-1; catalogue A-06 one-click step; was never typed in code (new in ADR-239)

settings.label: Alert distance with no playbook
settings.what_it_changes: The starting distance, in percent of the index level, at which a tracked strategy with no playbook is flagged near a short strike or a breakeven (0.5 means 0.5%); each user can set their own.
settings.source: ADR-222 (7), REQ-168 AC-1, AC-5; was ofo/adjustment/detection.py NEAR_LEVEL_THRESHOLD_PERCENT

settings.label: Gap-at-open check until
settings.what_it_changes: The starting clock time (930 means 09:30) until which the gap-at-open trigger is checked each day; each user can set their own.
settings.source: ADR-222 (7), REQ-168 AC-1, AC-5; was ofo/adjustment/playbook_eval.py _GAP_UNTIL

settings.label: Compare chart range
settings.what_it_changes: The starting range, in percent either side of the index level, the Compare payoff chart spans (6 means -6% to +6%); each user can set their own.
settings.source: ADR-222 (7), REQ-168 AC-1, AC-5; was ofo/adjustment/compare.py CURVE_RANGE

settings.label: Overnight gap size for the carry check
settings.what_it_changes: How big a gap, in percent of the index level, the carry check assumes at the next session's open when it shows what a strategy would make or lose before a weekend or holiday (2 means a 2% gap up and a 2% gap down).
settings.source: ADR-222 (1), REQ-167 AC-1, AC-4; was ofo/adjustment/carry.py CARRY_GAP_PCT

settings.label: Trending-day net delta per lot
settings.what_it_changes: How large the net delta per lot of the open legs must be, up or down, before the trending-day situation (S-02) opens and offers a roll (0.15 means plus or minus 0.15 per lot).
settings.source: ADR-222 (1), ADR-240 (3), REQ-167 AC-4; was ofo/adjustment/playbook_eval.py S02_NET_DELTA_PER_LOT

settings.label: Big early win, percent of maximum profit
settings.what_it_changes: How much of the maximum profit, in percent, a strategy must have made on its entry session before the big-early-win situation (S-12) opens and offers to take the profit (40 means 40%).
settings.source: ADR-222 (1), ADR-240 (3), REQ-167 AC-4; was ofo/adjustment/playbook_eval.py S12_PCT_OF_MAX_PROFIT

settings.label: Compare chart steps
settings.what_it_changes: The starting number of equal steps across the Compare chart's range (every strike inside it is added too); each user can set their own.
settings.source: ADR-222 (7), REQ-168 AC-1, AC-5; was ofo/adjustment/compare.py CURVE_STEPS

settings.label: Compare smaller move column
settings.what_it_changes: The starting size, in percent, of the smaller index move the Compare table shows P&L at, up and down; each user can set their own.
settings.source: ADR-222 (7), REQ-168 AC-1, AC-5; was ofo/adjustment/compare.py MOVES

settings.label: Compare larger move column
settings.what_it_changes: The starting size, in percent, of the larger index move the Compare table shows P&L at, up and down; each user can set their own.
settings.source: ADR-222 (7), REQ-168 AC-1, AC-5; was ofo/adjustment/compare.py MOVES

settings.label: Contract list is published at (IST, HHMM)
settings.what_it_changes: From what time each trading day the broker's contract list counts as published; a list loaded before it is treated as not yet current, and orders on it are refused as unconfirmed.
settings.source: Kite Connect docs: fetch the instrument list "once a day (ideally at around 08:30 AM)" (F-56); was catalogue_picker.py _PUBLISH_TIME

settings.label: Kite login expires at (IST, HHMM)
settings.what_it_changes: The time of day a Zerodha login is expected to lapse; a session is treated as expired from the next such time after its login (Kite's own refusal always wins).
settings.source: Kite Connect login-flow docs https://kite.trade/docs/connect/v3/user/ (tokens are invalidated daily around 06:00); not yet re-fetched, REQ-056 AC-10; was broker/session.py KITE_EXPIRY_TIME_IST

settings.label: Intraday (0-1 day to expiry): confirm on candle close
settings.what_it_changes: The candle length (aligned to 09:15) whose close must still be beyond a playbook line before an adjustment suggestion is raised; each user can set their own.
settings.source: REQ-170 AC-1, AC-6, ADR-237 (2); range 1 to 60: 1 minute is the shortest candle the checks build, beyond an hour a crossing is confirmed after the move is over; was ofo/adjustment/alert_gate.py INTRADAY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY

settings.label: Intraday (0-1 day to expiry): cool-down, same rule
settings.what_it_changes: The shortest time after a suggestion before the same rule may raise another one (one stage worse still raises at once); each user can set their own.
settings.source: REQ-170 AC-2, AC-6; range 1 to 375: 375 minutes is one whole market day (09:15 to 15:30); was ofo/adjustment/alert_gate.py INTRADAY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY

settings.label: Intraday (0-1 day to expiry): quiet time until
settings.what_it_changes: The clock time (930 means 09:30) before which a crossing is held as quiet time and raised at the first close after it; each user can set their own.
settings.source: REQ-170 AC-4, AC-6, ADR-237 (7); range 915 to 1530: the market day, a time outside it would never or always be quiet; was ofo/adjustment/alert_gate.py INTRADAY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY

settings.label: Intraday (0-1 day to expiry): re-arm margin

settings.label: Intraday (0-1 day to expiry): daily limit per strategy

settings.source: REQ-170 AC-4, AC-6, ADR-237 (7); range 1 to 20: 0 would hide every suggestion, above 20 is the noise REQ-170 removes (30 in 31 minutes on 2026-11-02); was ofo/adjustment/alert_gate.py INTRADAY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY

settings.source: REQ-170 AC-1, AC-6, ADR-237 (2); range 1 to 60: 1 minute is the shortest candle the checks build, beyond an hour a crossing is confirmed after the move is over; was ofo/adjustment/alert_gate.py INTRADAY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY

settings.what_it_changes: The shortest time after a suggestion before the same rule may raise another one (one stage worse still raises at once); each user can set their own.
settings.source: REQ-170 AC-2, AC-6; range 1 to 375: 375 minutes is one whole market day (09:15 to 15:30); was ofo/adjustment/alert_gate.py INTRADAY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY

settings.label: Weekly expiry: quiet time until
settings.what_it_changes: The clock time (930 means 09:30) before which a crossing is held as quiet time and raised at the first close after it; each user can set their own.
settings.source: REQ-170 AC-4, AC-6, ADR-237 (7); range 915 to 1530: the market day, a time outside it would never or always be quiet; was ofo/adjustment/alert_gate.py INTRADAY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY

settings.label: Weekly expiry: re-arm margin
settings.what_it_changes: How far, as a percent of the threshold, the value must clear the line before the same rule may raise a new suggestion; admin only.
settings.source: REQ-170 AC-2, AC-6, ADR-237 (1); range 1 to 50: below 1% every wobble re-arms, above 50% a rule may never re-arm in a day; was ofo/adjustment/alert_gate.py INTRADAY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY

settings.label: Weekly expiry: daily limit per strategy
settings.what_it_changes: The most adjustment suggestions one strategy raises in a day; further crossings are shown as held by the daily limit. A user may set a lower limit, never a higher one.
settings.source: REQ-170 AC-4, AC-6, ADR-237 (7); range 1 to 20: 0 would hide every suggestion, above 20 is the noise REQ-170 removes (30 in 31 minutes on 2026-11-02); was ofo/adjustment/alert_gate.py INTRADAY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY

settings.label: Monthly expiry: confirm on candle close
settings.what_it_changes: The candle length (aligned to 09:15) whose close must still be beyond a playbook line before an adjustment suggestion is raised; each user can set their own.
settings.source: REQ-170 AC-1, AC-6, ADR-237 (2); range 1 to 60: 1 minute is the shortest candle the checks build, beyond an hour a crossing is confirmed after the move is over; was ofo/adjustment/alert_gate.py INTRADAY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY

settings.label: Monthly expiry: cool-down, same rule
settings.what_it_changes: The shortest time after a suggestion before the same rule may raise another one (one stage worse still raises at once); each user can set their own.
settings.source: REQ-170 AC-2, AC-6; range 1 to 375: 375 minutes is one whole market day (09:15 to 15:30); was ofo/adjustment/alert_gate.py INTRADAY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY

settings.label: Monthly expiry: quiet time until
settings.what_it_changes: The clock time (930 means 09:30) before which a crossing is held as quiet time and raised at the first close after it; each user can set their own.
settings.source: REQ-170 AC-4, AC-6, ADR-237 (7); range 915 to 1530: the market day, a time outside it would never or always be quiet; was ofo/adjustment/alert_gate.py INTRADAY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY

settings.label: Monthly expiry: re-arm margin
settings.what_it_changes: How far, as a percent of the threshold, the value must clear the line before the same rule may raise a new suggestion; admin only.
settings.source: REQ-170 AC-2, AC-6, ADR-237 (1); range 1 to 50: below 1% every wobble re-arms, above 50% a rule may never re-arm in a day; was ofo/adjustment/alert_gate.py INTRADAY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY

settings.label: Background check interval, intraday (0-1 day to expiry)
settings.what_it_changes: The shortest time between two background playbook checks of one strategy of this trading style. A larger number means fewer checks and less server work.
settings.source: ADR-235 (1), REQ-166 AC-1, REQ-170 AC-6; range 1 to 600: under 1 s is faster than the worker wakes, over 10 minutes misses a candle close by more than the record timing allows (ADR-237 (3)); was ofo_app/calc_speeds.py KEY_BACKGROUND (one interval for every style)

settings.label: Lots an order starts at
settings.what_it_changes: How many lots a new order starts with on the order screen; you can change it on each order before you send it.
settings.source: Contract "Your adjustment settings" step 3 (ADR-245: two layers, admin default -> user; a plan never sets them); new, was never typed in code

settings.label: Price an order starts at
settings.what_it_changes: The limit price a new order starts at: 1 = mid of bid and ask (the default), 2 = last traded price, 3 = the price that fills now (ask to buy, bid to sell). You can change it on each order before you send it.
settings.source: Contract "Your adjustment settings" step 3 (ADR-245: two layers, admin default -> user; a plan never sets them); new, was never typed in code

settings.label: Order validity
settings.what_it_changes: How long a new order stays open at the exchange: 1 = for the day (DAY, the default), 2 = fill now or cancel (IOC). You can change it on each order before you send it.
settings.source: Contract "Your adjustment settings" step 3 (ADR-245: two layers, admin default -> user; a plan never sets them); new, was never typed in code
